svg.title: Terra Nexus - character costume turnaround
svg.desc: The main character in the wind shell at five angles, built from one cross-section model so the views agree with each other.
svg.text: Terra Nexus wind shell, Glacier Blue #5A90BE, slim athletic fit.
Hood worn down. Zipped. TERRA wraps the left cuff, NEXUS the right.
No shoulder mark, no sewn patch anywhere on the garment.
Dark charcoal technical trouser, slim. Low brown approach boot.
Mid-brown, mid-height ponytail, loose flyaway strands at the crown.
Athletic, approx. 168 cm. Jacket is size M.
HOW SHE READS IN THE STORY SET
Back and three-quarter back in every character scene -
The pack rides over the shell. Its shoulder straps cross
the front princess seams; the Deep Red patch sits centred
on the upper front panel of the pack, not on the jacket.
put a patch or any mark on the shoulder or upper arm -
the cuffs carry the wordmark now.
The story set never shows it - every frame is
from behind. Left deliberately unresolved here.
No front-facing reference exists. The front of
both the figure and the garment is specified.
Costume reference only - not a likeness. Garment geometry is taken from Output Drafts/Jacket.
